ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: Given: Line segment $AB = 6$, point $C$ is the midpoint of line segment $AB$, extend line segment $AB$ to $D$, such that $BD = 3BC$. Find the length of line segment $AD$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since point C is the midpoint of line segment AB,\\
therefore $BC=\frac{1}{2}AB$,\\
since AB = 6,\\
therefore BC = 3,\\
since BD= 3BC,\\
therefore BD= 9,\\
therefore AD=AB+BD=6+9=\boxed{15}
